pr.body:
Codex 0.167.0 writes delegated tasks as native `agent_message` items, with the observed plaintext task in an `encrypted_content` slot. The configured DeepSeek Responses gateway accepts those requests with HTTP 200 but the model does not receive the task. The tasks were present in child rollouts and wire requests; unloaded-child queue/resume errors were a separate control restriction.

Enable a route-specific adapter only for DeepSeek. It converts known inter-agent content to standard user messages, preserves text order and source/routing metadata, and rejects invalid or unknown content with sanitized HTTP 400 before forwarding. Other item types, provider routes, model/credential mapping, compression, guardian handling and ordinary streaming retain their existing behavior. The adapter assumes the observed slots contain plaintext; it cannot decrypt opaque ciphertext.

Validation: 71 focused/related tests passed, plus two actual DeepSeek native probe runs. The same child returned the exact initial and followup markers and consumed a separate send_message token. Another child executed `cat` on a random fixture whose contents were absent from its task and returned the exact contents. Baseline failure, setup failure, identities, ingress/egress, tool output and commands are retained under `docs/gateflow/shim-subagent-delivery/`.

No watchlist, scheduling ledger or business data changed. The running service has not been deployed. After merge and authorization, sync from the approved checkout with `./scripts/sync-codex-agent.sh`; it restarts the loaded launchd shim. Reopening Codex is not inherently required for this HTTP adapter; old failed tasks need a deliberate native followup and have not been recovered here.

Independent reviews ran in parallel via Claude mimo-flash and ds-flash. The accepted low-severity evidence privacy finding was fixed by the required gpt-6-sol delegate and passed both affected-surface re-reviews. A suggestion to classify hypothetical future top-level types by a string prefix was rejected with a recorded scope/contract reason. Full adjudication and residual owners are in `docs/gateflow/shim-subagent-delivery/review-adjudication.md`.
pr.title: Fix native Codex subagent messages on DeepSeek shim
